review_type: Independent single-agent source close reading; not clinical expert double adjudication
unit: The regex-matched span in each selected passage, not all statements in that passage

rows.title: The neuropharmacological basis for the use of memantine in the treatment of Alzheimer's disease. > Indications
rows.rationale: Several Alzheimer/nCD criteria and an all-3 sublist; a single all label does not encode their scopes or relations.

rows.title: Comprehensive Review on Alzheimer's Disease: Causes and Treatment.
rows.rationale: 'All of these symptoms can start from age 40–90' describes age of onset, not a requirement that every listed symptom be present. The passage also discusses diagnostic criteria, but this regex trigger supplies no all-of rule.

rows.title: Parkinsonism. > Epidemiology
rows.rationale: '2.5% to 5% of these cases' is prevalence; the digit 5 is not a k-of-n criterion.

rows.title: Psichiatry_DSM-5
rows.rationale: 'may be present in any of ... five psychotic disorders' lists disorders associated with catatonia, not alternative sufficient diagnostic findings.

rows.title: Psichiatry_DSM-5
rows.rationale: Good-prognosis specifier requires at least 2 features; the negative specifier must preserve the negated count. It is not the disease's base diagnostic rule.

rows.title: Neurology_Adams
rows.rationale: DLB source describes a 2-of-3 criterion, with separate descriptive features and historical/newer-criteria commentary.

rows.title: Psichiatry_DSM-5
rows.rationale: Schizophrenia criterion A has >=2 of 5 AND >=1 of the first 3 AND a time window; functioning is a separate necessary criterion.

rows.title: Psichiatry_DSM-5
rows.rationale: Catatonia requires >=3 of 12 distinct qualified symptoms. Last four members are repeated in the source window.

rows.title: Psichiatry_DSM-5
rows.rationale: 'criteria ... across all of these disorders' is metatext about DSM changes, not all member predicates required in a patient.

rows.title: First_Aid_Step1
rows.rationale: Mania includes >=3 symptoms plus duration/mood/impairment context; this window ends mid-list. Other disorders occur earlier in the window.

rows.title: Dermatopathology 101. Part 2 - Skin tumors. > Clinical Significance
rows.rationale: 'All of these conditions have the potential to progress to SCC' is a precursor-condition list, not a diagnostic conjunction.

rows.title: Recommendations > Recommendations > Recognising psoriasis > ng65-1_1_11
rows.rationale: Referral for spondyloarthritis assessment: persistent OR multiple sites OR an additional listed feature; action target is referral, not confirmed diagnosis.

rows.title: Septic arthritis following femoral neck fracture: A case report. > Evaluation
rows.rationale: Kocher count maps 1/2/3/4 findings to 3/40/93/99 percent in the supplied source; it is not one at-least-n hard criterion.

rows.title: Child Abuse and Neglect. > Differential Diagnosis
rows.rationale: Consider abuse in EACH listed scenario means ANY scenario can trigger consideration. Proxy labels all, reversing the connective and ignoring 'consider'.

rows.title: InternalMed_Harrison
rows.rationale: 'both because of these differences and because ...' coordinates reasons for a nomenclature choice, not patient findings.

rows.title: Bacterial Spine Infections in Adults: Evaluation and Management. > Pearls and Other Issues
rows.rationale: 'management includes all ... specialists' is an interprofessional team instruction.

rows.title: InternalMed_Harrison
rows.rationale: Two or more findings increase suspicion for epidural abscess; implication target is suspicion, not definitive diagnosis. Overlaps gid814520.

rows.title: IDSA Guidelines: Skin and Soft Tissue Infections > Introduction
rows.rationale: 'all of these ... scoring systems' evaluates diagnostic tools rather than conjoining their patient criteria.

rows.title: Neurology_Adams
rows.rationale: 'All of these drugs ... penetrate the blood–brain barrier' is pharmacology.

rows.title: Approach to a Child with Hypophosphatemia.
rows.rationale: 'calculate all of the above indicators' refers to a calculator, not patient diagnostic rules.

rows.title: The burden and epidemiology of community-acquired central nervous system infections: a multinational study. > Introduction
rows.rationale: Reference marker '[2] Of these forms' is mistaken for a count quantifier.

rows.title: InternalMed_Harrison
rows.rationale: Same epidural-abscess >=2 suspicion sentence as gid814521; overlapping windows are not independent source rules.

rows.title: Neurology_Adams
rows.rationale: 'In more chronic cases, all of these features are evident' is time-conditioned electrodiagnostic description, not explicit all-of diagnostic admission.

rows.title: Immediate surgery or conservative treatment for complicated acute appendicitis in children? A meta-analysis. > Assessment
rows.rationale: 'may or may not be accompanied by any ... symptoms' states optional findings; no member suffices for diagnosis.

rows.title: Recommendations > Recommendations > Symptoms and signs of complicated acute diverticulitis > ng147-1_3_2
rows.rationale: Diverticulitis suspicion is abdominal pain WITH alternatives (some nested conjunctions); overlaps gid27456. Complicated-diverticulitis referral is a separate rule.

rows.title: Recommendations > Recommendations > Symptoms and signs of acute diverticulitis > ng147-1_3_1
rows.rationale: Same abdominal-pain AND alternatives suspicion rule as gid27457, not a flat any-of list.

rows.title: Case report of traumatic abdominal wall hernia caused by seat belt. > Indications
rows.rationale: 'All of these layers are divided' describes surgical access through tissue layers.

rows.title: InternalMed_Harrison
rows.rationale: 'related both to ... factors of these species and ...' is an explanation of culture/virulence, not count logic.

rows.title: Epidemiology of uterine fibroids: a systematic review. > Histopathology
rows.rationale: Leiomyosarcoma >=2 of 3 histologic features, with numerical threshold and graded atypia. Source framing is tissue-specific.

rows.title: Disparities and Trends in Genitourinary Cancer Incidence and Mortality in the USA. > Introduction
rows.rationale: Citation '[5] About 60% of these tumors' is epidemiology, not k-of-n criteria.

rows.title: Ventricular Tachycardias: Characteristics and Management. > Evaluation
rows.rationale: Brugada algorithm diagnoses ventricular tachycardia when ANY one criterion holds. Vereckei aVR contains an ANY sublist. Regex all comes from unrelated 'both ... one of the above' span.

rows.title: Optic Neuritis. > Other Issues
rows.rationale: 'All of these etiologies can cause ... pressure' is a cause list, not a diagnostic conjunction.

rows.title: Chronic Rhinosinusitis with Nasal Polyps. > Differential Diagnosis
rows.rationale: 'All of the above differentials may be ruled out with biopsies' discusses a procedure and multiple diagnoses, not conjunction of patient features.

rows.title: [Diagnosis and Therapy of Immune thrombocytopenia]. > Differential Diagnosis
rows.rationale: 'three-quarters of these ... moderate to severe infections' is epidemiologic proportion, not a patient criterion.

rows.title: The incidence of congenital heart disease. > Function
rows.rationale: 'the two sides, one of the following defects may occur' is an anatomic defect list; two is not a threshold count. Overlaps gids399791/399792.

rows.title: The incidence of congenital heart disease. > Function
rows.rationale: Same anatomic defect list as gid399793; number two refers to heart sides.

rows.title: Pathology_Robbins
rows.rationale: Figure/table marker '11.2 ... majority of these (90%)' is incorrectly captured as count 2.

rows.title: Outcomes of Blalock-Taussig shunts in current era: A single center experience. > Anatomy and Physiology
rows.rationale: 'all deliveries, with about 25% of these cases' is prevalence, incorrectly classified all.

rows.title: Outcomes of Blalock-Taussig shunts in current era: A single center experience. > Anatomy and Physiology
rows.rationale: Same congenital-heart-disease prevalence statement as gid444828; not an independent all-of rule.

rows.title: The digital human forearm and hand. > Embryology
rows.rationale: 'All three of these regions fuse at 16 to 19 years' is embryology/ossification, not diagnostic conjunction.

rows.title: The incidence of congenital heart disease. > Function
rows.rationale: Same heart-side/defect list as gids399791/399793, not a k-of-n criterion.
